debian.preInit: sed -i 's|http://|https://|g' /etc/apt/sources.list.d/debian.sources; echo 'Acquire::https::CaInfo "/usr/local/share/ca-certificates/nixtrobox.crt";' > /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/99nixtrobox-ca; if command -v update-ca-certificates >/dev/null; then update-ca-certificates; fi

ubuntu.preInit: echo 'Acquire::https::CaInfo "/usr/local/share/ca-certificates/nixtrobox.crt";' > /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/99nixtrobox-ca; if command -v update-ca-certificates >/dev/null; then update-ca-certificates; fi
